summary.en: City on the regional weather map
summary.zh: 区域天气地图上的城市

detail.en: This dot marks Singapore on the map. The wind and rain readings describe the surrounding area; they are not measurements taken at a city weather station. City location: Natural Earth.
detail.zh: 这个点在地图上标出新加坡。风和雨的读数说明周围地区的情况，并非市内气象站的实测值。城市位置资料：Natural Earth。
